description: Description: Mow the grass before it grows back Rewards: - 2 Illuminati Points - 3,000 Karma Points

title: Photo Shoot
description: Description: Pose for the camera Objective: Talk to the Photographer and then pose in front of the camera. Rewards: - 1 Illuminati Point - 3,000 Karma Points

title: Collect G-O-A-T
description: Description: Complete all the courses Objectives: - Complete the [Beginners Course](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565989) - Complete the [Intermediate Course](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565992) - Complete the [Pro Course](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565991) Rewards: - 4 Illuminati Points - 3,000 Karma Points

title: Walk the Human
description: Description: Take the human for a walk Objective: Grab the leash next to Baartin Mohairrison and hold on. Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 3,000 Karma Points - [Leash (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565995)

title: Avian Invasion
description: Description: Chase away the birds Objective: Chase the human birds across the rooftops of Goatroit. Rewards: - 4 Illuminati Points - 3,000 Karma Points

title: Brotherly Mischief
description: Description: Prank Thor by destroying his statues Objective: Find and destroy the four [Thor Statues](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?search=thor_statue%20%26%26%20category%3A15341) located around Mount Olympus. Rewards: - 4 Illuminati Points - 3,000 Karma Points

title: Jam With the Bard
description: Description: Play a smokey tune with Orpheus Objective: Play Smoke on the Water on the lyre. While facing the lyre from the back, headbutt them in this order: 4-3-2-4-3-1-2-4-3-2-3-4 Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 3,000 Karma Points - [Lyre Horns](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566324)

title: The Search For Merch
description: Description: Find the elusive golden Zeus figurine Objective: Pick up a [Zeus Figurine](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?search=zeus_figurine%20%26%26%20category%3A15341) and take it to [Modest Midas](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566330) to turn it to gold, then bring it back to The God of Merch. Rewards: - 2 Illuminati Points - 3,000 Karma Points

title: Dining With The Stars
description: Description: Make some space food Location: Inside the [Microverse Rift](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566345). Objectives: - Combine the ingredients - Heat up the hot dog Rewards: - 3,000 Karma Points

title: Battle at the Summit
description: Description: Defeat the Hydra Rewards: - 4 Illuminati Points - 3,000 Karma Points - [Volty Bolty Horns](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566362) - Unlocks the [Godly Glow Fur](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566363) for purchase from the wardrobe

title: Snake Game
description: Description: Reach Medusa Objective: Move toward the Medusa statue when the eyes are blue, stop moving when the eyes are red. Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 3,000 Karma Points - Unlocks the [Medusa Outfit (Body)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566381) for purchase from the wardrobe

title: Equestrian Quest
description: Description: Sneak the wooden goat up the slopes. Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 3,000 Karma Points - [Centurion Armor (Body)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566389)

title: Got Your Nose!
description: Description: Find and return the Sphinx's nose Objective: Take the "Stolen Nose" from the [Hand Statue](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566396) on the eastern side of the [Immortal Vale](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565049) and bring it back to the Sphinx. You will need to use fire to clear roots for both. Rewards: - 2 Illuminati Points - 3,000 Karma Points - [Cleopatra Headpiece (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566400)

title: The Great Gastroscopy
description: Description: Find the last instability stone Location: Inside the [Chariot Rift](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566353) Objective: Find and dislodge the Kidney Stone. Rewards: - 3,000 Karma Points

title: Fly High With Balloons
description: Category: Goofville Objective: Grab a balloon from [Bob's Balloons](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565816) and fly off into the sky. Repeat this 5 times. Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Reach the Hovering Household
description: Category: Goofville Objective: Climb or fly to the [Hovering Household](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565007) in Goofville. Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Make 10 People Swim in Moisty Marina
description: Category: Goofville Objective: Lick and drag 10 NPCs into the water at the [Moisty Marina](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565008). Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Make an Olympian Get Zapped by an Angry Cloud
description: Category: Goofville Objective: Go to Mount Olympus and find any NPC. Lick and drag them all the way to Goofville to one of the angry clouds. Rewards: 3,500 Karma Points

title: Bring Something Golden Into the Coin Vault
description: Category: Goofville Prerequisite: [The Search For Merch](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566329) Objective: Equip the [Hands of Midas (Horns)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566342) and headbutt something to turn it into gold, then bring it to the coin vault at [Tax Exemption Hill](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565003). Rewards: 3,500 Karma Points

title: Get Launched by a Goat Scratcher
description: Category: Goatroit Objective: Find a Goat Scratcher in Goatroit, headbutt it and then run into it three times. Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Slide Down the Human Slide with a Goat
description: Category: Goatroit Objective: Lick and drag a goat-person down the clown slide in the [School Yard](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565036). Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Launch People with Goat Scratchers
description: Category: Goatroit Objective: Find a Goat Scratcher in Goatroit, headbutt it and then drag five people (or the same person five times) into it. Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Jump from One Train to the Other
description: Category: Goatroit Objective: At the dual-track rail in Goatroit, jump from the roof of one train to the one travelling in the opposite direction. Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Take a Photo With a Human Pet
description: Category: Goatroit Prerequisite: [Walk the Human](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565994) Objective: Equip the [Leash (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565995) and use it on a human. Talk to the Photographer and then pose for a photo with your human pet. Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Place People on the Train Tracks
description: Category: Goatroit Objective: Lick and drag 3 NPCs on to the train tracks in Goatroit. Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Drive Off the Vertical Ramp
description: Category: Goatroit Objective: Drive a vehicle up the vertical ramp in the north-west corner of Goatroit. Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Chase Bird People
description: Category: Goatroit Prerequisite: [Avian Invasion](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566006) Objective: Find and chase 15 birds around Goatroit after completing the [Avian Invasion](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566006) event. Rewards: 3,500 Karma Points

title: Baa on Top of Mount Olympus
description: Category: Mount Olympus Objective: Fly or climb to the top of [The Summit](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565050) in Mount Olympus and baa. Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Sit on the Sitting Lion's Head
description: Category: Mount Olympus Objective: Climb on top of the golden lion statue east of [Olympus Heights](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565048) and use the sit emote. Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Make Statues of Yourself
description: Category: Mount Olympus Objective: Stand on the marker in front of a block of marble and baa to carve a statue of yourself. Repeat this 5 times. This can be done at the same statue without moving. Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Turn Things Into Gold
description: Category: Mount Olympus Prerequisite: [The Search For Merch](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566329) Objective: Equip the [Hands of Midas (Horns)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566342) and headbutt 100 things to turn them into gold. Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Find Noir Alley
description: Category: Mount Olympus Objective: Locate Noir Alley on the very south edge of Mount Olympus. Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Play Exploding Hooves with an NPC
description: Category: Mount Olympus Rewards: 3,500 Karma Points

title: Launch Yourself from Multiverse Crystals
description: Category: Misc Objective: Jump from multiverse crystals 5 times. Multiverse crystals are floating purple crystals that turn into platforms on proximity. Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Travel Through Portals
description: Category: Misc Objective: Scattered around the Multiverse of Nonsense are portals, travel through 25 of them cumulatively. Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Headbutt an NPC into another NPC
description: Category: Misc Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Ride Along With a NPC for 60 Long Seconds
description: Category: Misc Objective: Approach a vehicle being driven by an NPC and hold the key to enter as a passenger, then stay in the vehicle for 60 seconds. Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Bounce on 5 Multiwursts in a Row
description: Category: Misc Prerequisite: [Microverse Rift](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566345) Objective: After completing the [Microverse Rift](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566345), large multiwursts will appear all over the world. Bounce on 5 of them in a row. Note: Using the [Hotdogian (Goat)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566426) from the [Meecrowahvay](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566424) secret event allows you to spawn your own multiwursts, making this much easier. Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Jump Through 2 Portals Within 10 Seconds
description: Category: Misc Objective: Scattered all around the Multiverse of Nonsense are small portals. Jump through 2 within 10 seconds. Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Make People Get Slammed by a Mouse Trap
description: Category: Misc Objective: Lick and drag three NPCs into mousetraps found around Goofville. Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points Note: You may need to complete the [Noisy Neighbor](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565096) event for mousetraps to spawn.

title: Give an NPC a Gem
description: Category: Misc Prerequisite: [Digging Deeper](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565770) Objective: After completing the [Miningverse Rift](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565679), gem nodes will spawn about Goatroit. Break one and drop it in front of any NPC. Rewards: 3,500 Karma Points

title: Pie Someone 3 Times
description: Category: Gear Required Gear: [Pie Thrower (Back)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565121) Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Place a Living Prop on Dr. Pilgor's Sofa
description: Category: Gear Prerequisite: [Trial Run](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565144) Objective: Enter the [TV Studio](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565034) via the [TV Studio Ventilation Duct](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565774) on the roof. Equip [Reinfaus (Goat)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565146) and use its ability to animate a nearby object. Lick and drag the animated object on to the sofa on the set of Dr. Pilgor. Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Let Your Hair Grow to 10 Meters
description: Category: Gear Prerequisite: [Vigorous Vegetation](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565980) Objective: Equip the [Grass Hair (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565981) and let it grow. This can take about 20 minutes. Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: I Could Walk 500 Meters With a Human
description: Category: Gear Prerequisite: [Walk the Human](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565994) Objective: Equip the [Leash (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565995) and use it on a human, then walk 500 meters with the human. Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Dance as the Missing Link With Another Missing Link
description: Category: Gear Prerequisite: [Evolution Excavation](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566009) Objective: Equip the [Missing Link (Goat)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566016) and dance with another Missing Link. NPCs have a rare chance to spawn a Missing Link after unlocking it. Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Chain 5 Throws Without Landing
description: Category: Gear Prerequisite: [Brotherly Mischief](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566306) Objective: Equip [Mjölner (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566319) and use its ability to throw the hammer and fly to it. Repeat this 5 times without landing. Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Place Some Lyres
description: Category: Gear Prerequisite: [Jam With the Bard](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566323) Objective: Equip the [Lyre Horns](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566324) and use its ability 20 times. Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Hit at Least 3 NPCs with a Lightning Bolt
description: Category: Gear Prerequisite: [Battle at the Summit](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566359) Objective: Equip the [Volty Bolty Horns](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566362) and use its ability to hit at least 3 NPCs with a single lightning bolt. Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Turn 5 People Into Stone at the Same Time
description: Category: Gear Prerequisite: [Snake Game](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566371) Objective: Equip the [Slither Locks (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566373) and use its ability to petrify 5 people at the same time. Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Miningverse Rift
description: Location: On top of the antiques store in Goatroit. Contains: - [Mining For Glory](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565681) (Event) - [Digging Deeper](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565770) (Event) - [You Mined Too Greedily and Too Deep](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565802) (Achievement) - [Mining Dwarf Beard (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565680) - [Mining Oar (Back)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565768) Completing this rift unlocks the Deep Stone.

title: Puzzleverse Rift
description: Location: On top of the largest cliff overlooking the [Perky Plaza](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565005) from the east. Prerequisites: - [Miningverse Rift](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565679) Contains: - [Trial of the Brain](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565938) (Event) - [Goat Got Brains](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565935) (Achievement) Completing this rift unlocks the Knowledge Stone.

title: Microverse Rift
description: Location: At the top of [The Summit](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565050) in Mount Olympus. Prerequisites: - [Miningverse Rift](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565679) - [Puzzleverse Rift](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565934) Contains: - [Dining With The Stars](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566349) (Event) - [Appliance in Disguise](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566391) (Achievement) - [Astronaut Backpack (Back)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566348) - [Astronaut Suit (Body)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566347) - [Astronaut Helmet (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566346) Completing this rift unlocks the Space Stone.

title: Chariot Rift
description: Prerequisites: - [Miningverse Rift](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565679) - [Puzzleverse Rift](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565934) - [Microverse Rift](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566345) Location: At the Epicenter, next to the Tiara of Instability. Contains: - [Gastroscopy](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566392) (Achievement)

title: Gone Home
description: Description: Visit your new home Previous Event: [Did You Read the Fine Print?](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565131) Rewards: - 2 Illuminati Points - 3,000 Karma Points

title: Garden Squatters
description: Description: "Take care of" the gnome infestation Objectives: - Exterminate the gnomes in the [Northern House](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565790) - Exterminate the gnomes in the [Central House](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565791) - Exterminate the gnomes in the [Southern House](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565792) Rewards: - 4 Illuminati Points - 3,000 Karma Points

title: Hoarding Ores
description: Description: Fill the vials with gems Prerequisite: [Digging Deeper](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565770) Objective: Collect 5 Umanite (green), 5 Channitatium (blue) and 5 Phazyonite (purple) gems from around Goatroit and bring them to [Molly](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565927). Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 3,000 Karma Points

title: Evolution Excavation
description: Description: Uncover the truth Prerequisite: [Mining For Glory](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565681) Objective: Use the [Mining Oar (Back)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565768) on the pearlescent rubble on the east side of the Excavation Site. Then headbutt the sheer rockface and bow in front of the Missing Link. Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 3,000 Karma Points - [Missing Link (Goat)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566016)

title: Parallel Parking
description: Description: Help park the fire truck Objective: Get in the fire truck and park it in the yellow zone next to the Parking Guard. Rewards: - 2 Illuminati Points - 3,000 Karma Points

title: Zeus' Cloud Service
description: Description: Password Hint - First Pet's Name Prerequisite: [Battle at the Summit](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566359) Objective: Jump on the keyboard and lick it. Rewards: - 1 Illuminati Point - 3,000 Karma Points

title: Marbellous!
description: Description: Create a statue of yourself! Objective: Stand on the marker in front of a block of marble and baa to turn it into a statue of yourself. Rewards: - 2 Illuminati Points - 3,000 Karma Points - [Ancient Hairdo (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566378) - Unlocks the [Marble Toga (Body)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566379) for purchase from the wardrobe.

title: High Roller
description: Description: Push the stone to the top of the hill Location: Inside the [Underground Chamber](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566411) Objective: Push the Stone of Sisyphus to the top of the ramp. Using the [Leash (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565995) from the [Walk the Human](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565994) event can trivialize this. Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 3,000 Karma Points

title: Meecrowahvay
description: Description: Enter the microwave Prerequisite: [Microverse Rift](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566345) Objective: After completing the [Microverse Rift](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566345), a microwave transformer will be hanging off the side of Mount Olympus. Enter the microwave. Rewards: - 1 Illuminati Point - 3,000 Karma Points - [Hotdogian (Goat)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566426)

title: Office Flipper
description: Description: Give Hades' office a makeover Objectives: - Knock down the walls - Sweep the floors - Unclog the toilet - Straighten the paintings Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 3,000 Karma Points - [Stress-Free Hair](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566435) - Unlocks the [Hades' Toga (Body)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566437) for purchase from the wardrobe

title: The Fall of a Hero
description: Description: Hit Achilles' weak spot Location: In the center of [Olympus Heights](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565048). Objective: Headbutt the heel of the Statue of Archilles Rewards: - 2 Illuminati Points - 3,000 Karma Points - [Achilles' Heelios (Feet)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=566442)

title: Broken Relic
description: Category: Goatroit #6 Location: Behind the TV screen of the Dr. Pilgor set inside the [TV Studio](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565034). Access via the [TV Studio Ventilation Duct](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565774) on the roof.

title: Broken Relic
description: Category: Goofville #1 Location: On top of the lighthouse in the [Moisty Marina](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565008).

title: Broken Relic
description: Category: Goofville #2 Location: At the bottom of a mineshaft in [Chafing Cracks](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565010). Use the [TNT Detonator](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565797) opposite to clear the boulder.

title: Broken Relic
description: Category: Goofville #3 Location: On the doorstep of the [Hovering Household](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565007) on the west side of Goofville.

title: Broken Relic
description: Category: Goofville #4 Location: On the wooden platforms on the north side of [Chafing Cracks](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565010).

title: Broken Relic
description: Category: Goofville #5 Location: On top of the coin vault at [Tax Exemption Hill](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/multiverse-of-nonsense?locationIds=565003).

title: Trespassing!

title: Dilbo's Journey
description: Description: The ring must be taken deep into Mount Inferno and cast back into the fiery chasm from whence it came Objectives: Take the [Purity Ring (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558090) from Dilbo's House and take it to [Mount Inferno](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558091). Inside the mountain, jump in to the lava and you'll end up at Platform 24/7. Keep going along the platform until you arrive back at Dilbo's House. Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points - [Pilgor the Grey (Body)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558093) - [Wizard Hat (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558092)

description: Description: Use force to play a march Objective: Climb or fly to the bell tower of the [Cross Fit](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558222) church in [Brumehill Cemetery](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557899) and play the Imperial March on the bells. Solution: Middle, Middle, Middle, Left, Right, Middle, Left, Right, Middle. Rewards: - 4 Illuminati Points - 8,500 Karma Points - Access to the [Pridesaber 2.0 (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558232)

title: Crack in Time
description: Description: Investigate the crack Rewards: - 1 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points - Unlocks the [Decade Cake (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558237) for purchase from the wardrobe

title: Birthday Crack
description: Description: Investigate the birthday crack Next Event: [Birthday Presents](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558247) Rewards: - 1 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points

title: Birthday Presents
description: Description: Find all the fallen presents Objective: Find the 12 [Fallen Present](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?search=fallen_present+%26%26+category:15341) boxes spread across the map Previous Event: [Birthday Crack](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558244) Rewards: - 1 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points - [Plushie (Goat)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558628)

title: Cooking Class
description: Description: Let your taste buds guide you Objectives: Lick and drag three items in to the cooking pot Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points - [Master Chef (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558632)

title: Swedes Assemble!
description: Description: Help Sven build a piece of Sweden Objectives: Find and headbutt the blue Swekia branded boxes in and around Sven's house to find furniture pieces. Bring the furniture pieces to the blue mat in-front of Sven Rewards: - 5 Illuminati Points - 8,500 Karma Points - Access to the [Portal to Swekia Warehouse](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558635)

title: Moving Help
description: Description: Put the boxes in the garage Objectives: Find 40 pink Stork Storage boxes around the house and drag them in to the garage Rewards: - 1 Illuminati Points - 50 Karma Points

title: Practicing Shrink
description: Description: Take a seat and bah your problems Objectives: Jump on the red chaise lounge inside the shrink's house and baa Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points

title: The Ballerina Effect
description: Description: Push them to perfection Objectives: Headbutt the three ballerinas to make them spin faster Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points - [Prima Ballerina (Body)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558669)

title: Happy Birthday Philip!
description: Description: No one RSVP'ed Objectives: Lick and drag 3 people to Philip's birthday party Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points - [Clown Dress (Body)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558672) - Unlocks [Balloon Animal (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558673) for purchase from the wardrobe - Unlocks [Clown Wig (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558674) for purchase from the wardrobe - Unlocks [Clown Shoes (Feet)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558675) for purchase from the wardrobe

title: End of the World?
description: Description: Prep the bunker with super important stuff Objectives: Lick and drag any three items in to the chute beside the bunker hatch Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points - Access to the [Bunker](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558679)

title: Friendly New Neighbours
description: Description: Have a cupcake, dear Objectives: Pick up a cupcake and then defeat the housewives Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points - Unlocks [Karen's Hair (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558717) for purchase from the wardrobe - Unlocks [Donna's Beehive (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558716) for purchase from the wardrobe - Unlocks [Donna's Dress (Body)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558719) for purchase from the wardrobe - Unlocks [Nancy's Dress (Body)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558721) for purchase from the wardrobe

title: The Big Red Button
description: Description: What's the worst that could happen? Objectives: - Set the latitude and longitude to the highest settings - Headbutt the launch button - Go to the unexploded nuke that lands and headbutt it Rewards: - 5 Illuminati Points - 10,000 Karma Points - [Fallout Boi (Body)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558731)

title: Artsy Fartsy
description: Description: Contribute to the sculpture Objectives: Drag three people or objects on to the metal tree sculpture Note: Using only humans for this will complete the [Make Modern Art With Humans Only](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557938) instinct Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points

title: Bird Watching
description: Description: And now we wait... Objectives: Use the observation telescope in the bird-watching tower until you spot a bird Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points

title: Bigfoot Sighted
description: Description: Prove the unprovable Objectives: Lick and drag [Becky with the Big Feet](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558757) from her camp to the north in to the cage Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points - [Homo Sapiens (Feet)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558759) - Unlocks [Birthday Suit (Fur)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558762) for purchase in the wardrobe

title: A Log Story Short
description: Description: Bring lumberjacks to fix the machine Objectives: Lick and drag two lumberjacks from nearby to form a human chain to power the log machine Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points - [Hipster Uniform (Body)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558768)

title: Clean Energy
description: Description: Activate the wind turbines Objectives: Power the two inactive wind turbines either side of the house by removing batteries from any of the four nearby active wind turbines Rewards: - 4 Illuminati Points - 7,500 Karma Points

title: Free Billy
description: Description: Rescue that poor thing Objectives: Headbutt the glass to free Billy and then use any means available to relocate him to the ocean to the west Rewards: - 4 Illuminati Points - 8,500 Karma Points

title: Missing: Rosie
description: Description: Find and bring back Rosie Objectives: Follow the trail of rhino poop leading north of the [San Angora Zoo](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557895) to find Rosie and bring her back to her enclosure at the zoo Rewards: - 4 Illuminati Points - 8,500 Karma Points - [Angry Goat](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558791) - [Rosie's Sister (Fur)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558794)

title: X on the Beach
description: Description: Grab that booty Objectives: Stand on the red X on the beach to lure attacks from the kraken tentacles until the treasure is revealed Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points

title: Puppet Show
description: Description: Put on a play! Objectives: - Act 1 - Humble Beginnings - Act 2 - Not Quite My Tempo - Act 3 - Goat Enough Rewards: - 1 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points

title: Character Creation
description: Description: Become your final form! Objectives: - Bring a headpiece - Bring a body piece - Bring a weapon - Bring a shield Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points

title: Fishing for Bob
description: Description: Find the elusive blobfish Objective: Use the fishing rods to fish in the pools until you find Bob Rewards: - 1 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points

title: Under Pressure
description: Description: Bring some workers to lift the container Objective: Lick and drag three dock workers from nearby to the container Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points - [Caution (Back)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558815)

title: Shift Switch
description: Description: Knock the workers off the lunch beam Objective: Control the crane and swing it until the workers fall off the beam Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points

title: Run for President
description: Description: Win the election Objectives: - Enter the race - Influence the voters! Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points

title: Mission Impossible
description: Description: The Heist of the Century Objective: Steal The Royal Crown Jewels from inside the [Tower of the People](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561703) exhibit. Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points - [Ocean's 1 (Body)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561702)

title: Curator
description: Description: Restore the street art to its former glory. Objective: Pick up and equip the [Baanksy (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561705) and use it to "restore" the four [Street Arts](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?search=street_art%20%26%26%20category%3A15341) Rewards: - 4 Illuminati Points - 8,500 Karma Points

title: Wanted: Whistleblowers
description: Description: Put those noisy whistleblowers behind bars! Objective: Bring [Goldilocks](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561715), [Tinker Bell](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561718) and [Big Bad Wolf](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561719) to holding cells inside the [City of San Angora Police Department](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561717) Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points - [Police Cap (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561720)

title: Community Service
description: Description: Clear the area from all the trash Objective: Move all of the trash bags away from the tennis court Rewards: - 1 Illuminati Points - 50 Karma Points

title: Sandcastles in the Sand
description: Description: Build a new & better sand sculpture Objectives: - Headbutt the mermaid sand sculpture to destroy it - Find 5 filled buckets of sand along the beach or fill empty buckets by destroying sandcastles - Bring the filled buckets of sand to destroyed mermaid sand sculpture Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points - Access to [de_sand2](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561726)

title: The Lost Tapes
description: Description: Recover the relics Objective: Find one of the [Lost Tape](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?search=lost_tape%20%26%26%20category%3A15341) and bring it back to the [Renarde (Movie Theater)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561732), inserting it into the Panamastic machine inside. Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points

title: Plunger Practice
description: Description: Hit all three moving targets! Objective: Rewards: - 1 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points

title: Hobo the Grey
description: Description: Help him build a home Objectives: - Bring a trashbag - Bring another trashbag - Bring an awesome looking cardboard box Rewards: - 1 Illuminati Point - 1 Karma Point - [Pixie Wings (Back)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561747) - Access to [Hoboria](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561748)

title: The Founding Father
description: Description: Reel it in Objective: Fly or climb on to the statue's fishing rod and headbutt the reel (handle) repeatedly until the lighthouse is fully out of the water Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points

title: Do a Backflip
description: Objective: While walking backwards, jump and hold the flip button to perform a backflip. Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Do A Triple Jump
description: Objective: Press Jump as soon as you land two chain jumps together. Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Pin An Instinct
description: Category: How to Be a Goat Objective: Open the Quests menu and go to Instincts, then select the Pin icon next to any Instinct. Reward: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Reach Warp Speed While Grinding
description: Category: How To Be A Goat Objective: Head to the bridge between Libertarian Island and Downtown and jump on the hand rail to grind. Keep grinding on the hand rail until reaching maximum speed. Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Equip Something In All Wardrobe Spots
description: Category: How To Be A Goat Objective: Open the Wardrobe menu and equip something in each of the slots: Goat, Head, Body, Back, Feet, Fur, Horns, Baa. Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Do An Emote
description: Objective: Perform any emote from the emote wheel. Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Do a 720 Double Front or Backflip
description: Category: How To Be A Goat Objective: Jump off a moderately high building while spinning (left to right) and front/back flipping (forward/back). Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Use Water To Extinguish Yourself
description: Category: How To Be A Goat Objective: Set yourself on fire and then run in to water to put yourself out. An easy spot to do this is behind the [Fossil Fuel](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558004) gas station. Headbutt the propane tank behind the building and then jump in to the ocean. Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Bounce On a Trampoline 10 Times in a Row
description: Category: Misc Objective: Find a [Trampoline](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?search=trampoline%20%26%26%20category%3A15341) and bounce on it 10 times without missing Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Explode An Explosive With An Explosive
description: Category: Misc Objective: Find something explosive, such as a red barrel, and throw it at something else explosive. There's a group of explosive barrels at the [Solar Panel Farm](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=564742) in Fairmeadows Ranch that makes this easy. Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Get Caught by the Police
description: Category: Misc Objective: Headbutt people while near a police officer and let them catch you. Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Drive a Firetruck
description: Category: Misc Objective: Drive a firetruck. The easiest way to spawn a firetruck is to head to a [Fossil Fuel](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?search=fossil_fuel%20%26%26%20category%3A15328) gas station and headbutt the petrol pumps to cause an explosion. A firetruck should eventually come to the scene. Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Lick Someone for 1 Minute
description: Category: Misc Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Explode 10 People at the Same Time
description: Category: Misc Objective: Hit 10 people with the same explosion. The easiest way to do this is to lick and drag ten people together at a [Fossil Fuel](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?search=fossil_fuel%20%26%26%20category%3A15328) gas station and then headbutt the pump to cause it to explode. Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Expose a Trash Man
description: Objective: Headbutt a trash can with a lid on it to expose a trash man. A great spot for this is the [Instinct Shrine in Downtown](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557923) which is surrounded by trash cans. Rewards: 1,000 Karma Points

title: Take a Bath At Yakedo Hot Springs
description: Category: Fairmeadows Ranch Objective: Jump in to the water at [Yakedo Hot Springs](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557901). Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Reach the Highest Point of Fairmeadows Ranch
description: Category: Fairmeadows Ranch Objective: Fly or climb to the top of the tallest electricity pylon near Fairmeadows Ranch. Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Get Scaled Down
description: Category: Fairmeadows Ranch Objective: Complete the [Backyard Science](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558049) event and then jump in to the machine twice. Rewards: 3,500 Karma Points

title: Make a Scarecrow Dance With You
description: Category: Fairmeadows Ranch Objective: After completing the [Children of the Hay](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558062) event, random scarecrows will spawn in place of normal NPCs around the world. Use the dance emote next to one until they dance with you. Note: The three scarecrows you re-animate as part of the event do not count. Rewards: 3,500 Karma Points

title: Reach the Highest Point of The Pointy Foods Factory
description: Category: [Pointy Foods Factory](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557900) Objective: Climb or fly to the top of the tallest chimney stack in the [Pointy Foods Factory](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557900) Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Lick the Hermit
description: Category: [Pointy Foods Factory](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557900) Objective: Lick Hermit Herman, found in a crater on the hill on the north side of the [Pointy Foods Factory](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557900) Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Lay Dead in a Grave
description: Category: [Brumehill Cemetery](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557899) Objective: Toggle ragdoll mode in the empty grave in [Brumehill Cemetery](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557899) Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Reach the Highest Point of The Brumehill Cemetery
description: Category: [Brumehill Cemetery](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557899) Objective: Fly or climb on top of the [Cross Fit](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558222) church steeple Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Force a Ghost to Workout
description: Category: [Brumehill Cemetery](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557899) Objective: Headbutt a gravestone in [Brumehill Cemetery](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557899) to release a ghost, then lick and drag the ghost in to [Cross Fit](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558222) and on to a treadmill Prerequisite: [Pay Respect](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558220) Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Jump from the Highest Diving Board
description: Category: Suburbsville Objective: Climb or fly on to the tallest diving board at the [Pool Party](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557897) and jump in to the pool Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Reach the Highest Point of Suburbsville
description: Category: Suburbsville Objective: Fly or climb to the top of the electricity pylon south of the [5G Tower](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561905) sub-station on the far east side of Suburbsville. Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Make Modern Art With Humans Only
description: Category: Suburbsville Objective: Use only humans to decorate the metal tree sculpture as part of the [Artsy Fartsy](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558739) event Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Find What's Hiding in the Sewers
description: Category: Suburbsville Objective: Enter the [Sewer](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561931) in [Sverige](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557898) and find "That" dancing Rewards: 3,500 Karma Points

title: Put Construction Workers in the Cement Mixer
description: Category: [Construction Site](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557896) Objective: Lick and drag 3 workers in to an orange cement mixer. Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Reach the Top of the Crane
description: Category: [Construction Site](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557896) Objective: Fly or climb to the top of the crane at the [Construction Site](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557896) Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Get Someone to Pet You
description: Category: Misc Objective: Stand idle somewhere near NPCs as a normal goat and eventually someone will approach and pet you. Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Reach Highest Point of Mornwood Falls
description: Category: Mornwood Falls Objective: Climb or fly to the top of the [Goat Tower](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557879) at [Windtop](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557892). Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Take a Bite of the Lumberjack Hat
description: Category: Mornwood Falls Objective: Stand on top of one of the lumberjack statues and use the graze emote. Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Reach the Top of the Mountain With a Vehicle
description: Category: Mornwood Falls Objective: Drive a vehicle up to the [Goat Tower](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557879) at [Windtop](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557892). Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Reach Highest Point of Sawmill
description: Category: [Sawmill](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557891) Objective: Climb or fly to the top of the tallest chimney at the [Sawmill](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557891). Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Reach Highest Point of San Angora Zoo
description: Category: [San Angora Zoo](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557895) Objective: Fly or climb to the top of the water tower next to the [Dolphin Show](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558171) in the [San Angora Zoo](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557895). Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Jump Through The Rhino Statue Hole
description: Category: [San Angora Zoo](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557895) Objective: Jump or fly through the tongues of the rhino statue outside [San Angora Zoo](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557895). Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Exit Through The Gift Shop
description: Category: [San Angora Zoo](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557895) Objective: Enter the [San Angora Zoo](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557895) [Gift Shop](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561938) and then exit it again. Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Jump Off The Hoofer Dam as Steve
description: Category: [Hoofer Dam](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557890) Prerequisite: [Rescue Steve](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558006) Objective: Equip [Steve (Goat)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558007) and jump off the [Hoofer Dam](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557890). Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Balance Objects On The 5 Posts
description: Category: [Hoofer Dam](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557890) Objective: Balance five objects on the wooden posts in the [Hoofer Dam](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557890) reservoir. Rewards: 3,500 Karma Points Note: Utilizing the building abilities of [The Farmer (Goat)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=562023) after completing the game can trivialize this.

title: Taunt the Police House
description: Category: Downtown Objective: Use the buttshake emote outside the [City of San Angora Police Department](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561717) in Downtown. Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Reach the Highest Point of Downtown
description: Category: Downtown Location: The very top of the antenna on top of the [Tower of the People](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561703) building in Downtown Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Take a Person Shopping
description: Category: Downtown Objective: Lick and drag any NPC in to one of the stores in Downtown. Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Find the Hackerspace
description: Category: Downtown Objective: Enter the [Hackerspace](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561958) located in an underground tunnel accessed behind the [City of San Angora Police Department](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561717) in Downtown. Follow the "Gov Not" graffiti on the walls. Rewards: 3,500 Karma Points

title: Take the Scenic Route in the Balloon Cart
description: Category: Downtown Prerequisite: [Go Big](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561891) Objective: Fly up to the floating goat balloon that's circling Downtown after completing the [Go Big](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561891) secret event and jump in the shopping basket hanging underneath it. You must stay in the basket for 10 seconds. Rewards: 3,500 Karma Points

title: Bring a Date to the Movies
description: Category: Goatenburg Objective: Lick and drag any NPC in to the [Renarde (Movie Theater)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561732) in Goatenburg. Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Dance at the Rave
description: Category: Goatenburg Objective: Enter [Räva Rave](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561976) in central Goatenburg and use the dance emote at the rave. Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Reach Highest Point of Goatenburg
description: Category: Goatenburg Objective: Stand on top of the golden globe on the top of the [Goldball Sachs](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561870) building in Goatenburg and headbutt it until it's at its highest point. Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Turn Sunbathers in Seabathers
description: Category: Goatenburg Objective: Lick and drag sunbathers on the [Capracabana](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557886) beach into the water. Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Take a Hobo to the Hair Salon
description: Category: Goatenburg Objective: Drag a hobo to the barber chair at Style by Henri. Note: A hobo can be found by the garbage bins directly behind Style by Henri. Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Make Out With The Whale
description: Category: Goatenburg Objective: Stand on the red buoy off the east coast of Goatenburg to get swallowed by the whale. Once inside, navigate over to the whale's tongue and lick it. Rewards: 3,500 Karma Points

title: Reach the Highest Point of Libertarian Island
description: Category: Libertarian Island Objective: Fly or climb to the top of the Statue of the Libertarian's head on Libertarian Island. Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Get Fished by a Fisherman
description: Category: Misc Objective: Find a fisherman casting his line and swim on to the bobber. He has to pull you fully out of the water, this may take multiple attempts Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Slip on Some Bananas
description: Category: Misc Objective: Bananas can be found all over the game, simply run over them 5 times. Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Travel Through Vents
description: Category: Misc Objective: Travel through 5 vents found anywhere in the game. The same vent can be repeated multiple times. Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Use Fireworks to Fly Through the Air
description: Category: Misc Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points Note: An easy place to find fireworks is the [Boom Fireworks](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558188) store in Downtown.

title: Jump on a Ramp With a Bike
description: Category: Misc Objective: Jump any of the [Ramps](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?search=ramp%20%26%26%20category%3A15334) around the map while riding a pedal bike. Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Knock Over Bajamaja's
description: Category: Misc Objective: Headbutt blue portable toilets found around the map. Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Have a Poolparty With 10 People
description: Category: Misc Objective: Fill the swimming pool with 10 people by licking and dragging them in Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Create a Human Electric Chain
description: Category: Misc Objective: Headbutt electrical objects, such as a street lamp, to get electrocuted while in a crowded area so the electricity arcs between at least five people in a chain. Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Hit a Postman With a Newspaper
description: Category: Misc Objective: Find a postman throwing newspapers. Pick up one of the newspapers and hit the postman with it. Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Play Catch with a Person
description: Category: Misc Objective: Find a ball and place it in-front of an NPC to engage a game of catch with them. Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Do a the Legendary Twisty McGoat Trick
description: Category: Misc Objective: Perform a quadruple front or backflip. Rewards: 3,500 Karma Points

title: Get a Police To Handcuff a Colleague
description: Category: Misc Objective: Headbutt a police officer to aggravate them and then run in the path of another police officer so they get hit by the handcuffs. Rewards: 3,500 Karma Points

title: Force 5 People Into One Bouncy Castle
description: Category: Misc Objective: Lick and drag 5 people on to a bouncy castle at one time. Tip: Carefully balancing unconscious people on the front of the bouncy castle can prevent them from bouncing around Rewards: 3,500 Karma Points

title: Make a Firefighter Extinguish a Burning Police Officer
description: Category: Misc Objectives: - Lick and drag a police officer from the [City of San Angora Police Department](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561717) and take them to the the [Fossil Fuel](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561710) gas station on the west side of Downtown. - Headbutt the petrol pumps at the gas station to cause a fire. When the firetruck arrives, lick and drag the police officer into the flames until the firefighter extinguishes them. Rewards: 3,500 Karma Points

title: Crash Into Rosie Using The Rhino Tractor
description: Category: Misc Prerequisite: [Missing: Rosie](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558789) Objective: Find the [Rhino Tractor](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=564663) in Downtown and take it to [San Angora Zoo](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557895) and drive into Rosie in the rhino enclosure. Rewards: 3,500 Karma Points

title: Ride a Bike for 30 Seconds
description: Category: Misc Objective: Find and ride a pedal bike for 30 seconds. The bike must be moving for this to count. Rewards: 3,500 Karma Points

title: Slap People With a Fish
description: Category: Gear Required Gear: [Mermaid Comb (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558053) Objective: Shoot fish at 15 different people. Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Make 15 Magic Plants Grow 15 Times Each
description: Category: Gear Required Gear: [Gardener (Back)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558016) Objective: Plant 15 magic plants, then baa at them to make them grow 15 times each. Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Change the Color of Bikes
description: Category: Gear Required Gear: [Ricer (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558080) Objective: Change the color of 10 different bikes Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Turn 3 People Into Abominanas at the Same Time
description: Category: Gear Required Gear: [Abominana (Goat)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558205) Objective: Turn three people into Abominanas. All three people must be hit with the same projectile. Find crowded areas with lots of people, such as [Coscon](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557889). Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Send People to Heaven
description: Category: Gear Required Gear: [Holy Hook (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558239) Objective: Send 50 people to heaven. Rewards: 3,500 Karma Points

title: Send Ghosts to Heaven
description: Category: Gear Objective: Equip the [Holy Hook (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558239) and use it's ability to send 5 ghosts to heaven. Ghosts can be found by breaking the gravestones at [Brumehill Cemetery](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557899) Rewards: 3,500 Karma Points

title: Turn Reporter Nick Famzi Jr to a Dare Devil
description: Category: Goatenburg Objective: Find [Nick Famzi Jr](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?search=nick_famzi_jr%20%26%26%20category%3A15341) and drag him over to [Hank Havoc's Daredevil Cannon](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=564668) and fire him out of it. Rewards: 3,500 Karma Points Note: [Nick Famzi Jr](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?search=nick_famzi_jr%20%26%26%20category%3A15341) can spawn in multiple places around the world.

title: Attach Rockets to 3 People in a Row
description: Category: Gear Required Gear: [Firework Launcher (Back)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=562707) Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Create Floating Cars

description: Category: Gear Required Gear: [Pizza Delivery (Back)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558666) Rewards: 3,500 Karma Points

title: Give a Firefighter a New Accessory
description: Category: Gear Required Gear: [Fashionista (Back)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561997) Rewards: 3,500 Karma Points Note: The easiest way to spawn a firefighter is to blow up the petrol pumps at a [Fossil Fuel](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?search=fossil_fuel%20%26%26%20category%3A15328) gas station.

title: Play in VR for 5 Minutes
description: Category: Gear Required Gear: [VR Headset (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=562025) Rewards: 3,500 Karma Points

title: Get Kicked as Bob
description: Category: Gear Required Gear: [Bob (Fur)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558809) Objective: Let NPCs kick you 15 times while dressed as Bob. Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Have 7 Puppets Follow You
description: Category: Gear Required Gear: [Puppet Goat](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558798) Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Grapple 250m Without Landing
description: Category: Gear Required Gear: [Grappling Bow](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561745) Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Drive the Toy Car at High Speed for 20 Seconds
description: Category: Gear Required Gear: [Wheeler Deeler (Back)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=564903) Objective: The [Wheeler Deeler (Back)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=564903) grants the ability to spawn a vehicle by holding down the key. While held, the car will race around the track on your back. Tap the key to keep the car at speed, but releasing it often enough that it doesn't finish and spawn the vehicle. Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Big Egg on Little Island
description: Description: Find a way to open the biggest egg on [Easter Island](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557902) Objectives: - Go to [Easter Island](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557902) - Open the [Biggest Egg](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558201) Rewards: - 1 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points Previous Event: [Egg Crackdown](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558153)

title: Fit for the Cross
description: Description: Motivate people to run Location: Inside the church at [Brumehill Cemetery](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557899). Objective: Lick and drag four NPCs on to the treadmills inside [Cross Fit](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558222) Prerequisite: [Pay Respect](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558220) Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points - Access to the ["Angel Sweat" Car](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558226)

title: de_sand2
description: Description: Defend A Prerequisite: [Sandcastles in the Sand](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561725) Location: Found inside [de_sand2](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561726) Objective: Defeat the waves of sand people Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points - [King of Sand (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561728)

title: Forbidden Fruit
description: Description: God tier snack Location: In the grassy area in the south of Fairmeadows Ranch, west of [Redneck Haven](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557903) and east of the [Solar Panel Farm](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=564742). Objective: Headbutt the golden apple from the tree Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points - Unlocks the [The Ark (Back)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561756) for purchase from the wardrobe

title: Oopsie
description: Description: Detach the gum Location: Opposite the [Fossil Fuel](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558004) in the west side of Fairmeadows Ranch. Objective: Dislodge the chewing gum from the grain silo Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points

title: Home Grown Chicken
description: Description: Feed the chicken Location: The chicken farm at Fairmeadows Ranch, directly west of [Brumehill Cemetery](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557899). Objective: Ring the dinner bell and throw yourself in the food bowl to get eaten by the chicken Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points

title: Self Reflection
description: Description: Find your peace Objective: Stand on a yoga mat in [Chatana Yoga](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558193) for 5 minutes without moving Rewards: - 4 Illuminati Points - 8,500 Karma Points - [Lotus Power (Back)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561758) - Unlocks the [Beauty, Mindfulness and Meditation](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561759) achievement

title: Treehuggers
description: Description: Get those stinkin' hippies off of those poor trees! Objective: Find and headbutt the hippies off the trees around the Mornwood Falls hiking trail. Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points - [Flower Power (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561866)

title: Horror Corridor
description: Description: Survive... Location: Inside the [Horror Corridor](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561867) found by entering the Rest Stop at [Quiet Hill](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557894). Objective: Keep progressing through the corridors until escaping. Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points - [Sheet (Body)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561869)

title: Global Warming
description: Description: Reach the sun Objective: Repeatedly headbutt the large golden globe on the top of the [Goldball Sachs](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561870) building in Goatenburg Rewards: - 4 Illuminati Points - 8,500 Karma Points

title: Crash Site
description: Description: Investigate the spaceship Prerequisite: [Global Warming](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561871) Objective: Headbutt the crashed UFO on the top of the mountain in Mornwood Falls. Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points

title: Dam It
description: Description: Give someone a "Once in a Lifetime" tour of the dam Objective: Climb in to [Hank Havoc's Daredevil Cannon](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=564668) and fire yourself at the [Hoofer Dam](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557890). Rewards: - 5 Illuminati Points - 10,000 Karma Points

title: Belly of the Beast
description: Description: Find a way out Objective: Land on the large red buoy off the east coast of Goatenburg to get eaten by a whale. Once inside, find a way to headbutt the uvula that's dangling above three times. Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points

title: Octo-Bonk
description: Description: Bonk the octopus in the fontanel Objective: In central Goatenburg, drive a vehicle up the ramp on the north east side of the giant octopus statue, crashing it in to the statue Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points

title: Styled by Henri
description: Description: Give someone a new hairdo Objective: Drag an NPC in to the barber chair at Style by Henri Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points - [Barber (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561880)

title: Sword in the Stone
description: Description: Drag the sword out of the stone Location: Behind [Coscon](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557889), directly south of the [Goat Tower](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557880) Objective: Lick the sword and run backwards to pull it free. Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points - [The Doomslayer (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561882)

title: Free Money
description: Description: "Withdraw" 500 moneys from ATM machines Objective: Headbutt an ATM machine 500 times Rewards: - 2 Illuminati Points - 500 Karma Points - [Dunce (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561887)

title: Go Big
description: Description: Inflate the goat balloon Location: In the center of Downtown, between the [Lûx](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561890) fashion store and [Fossil Fuel](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561710) gas station. Objective: Repeatedly jump on the balloon pump to inflate the goat balloon. Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points

title: Exterminator
description: Description: Swat the bug Location: On top of the "Swat It" billboard in Downtown, outside the [Culture](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561902) store Objective: Headbutt the red fly swatter as Fly-Man is about to fly past, causing him to get swatted by it. Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points

title: 5G Upgrade
description: Description: Find and activate all [5G towers](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?search=5g_tower%20%26%26%20category%3A15341) Location: Start by activating any of the three [5G towers](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?search=5g_tower%20%26%26%20category%3A15341). Rewards: - 5 Illuminati Points - 10,000 Karma Points

title: Day and Night Cycle
description: Description: Touch the bulb Prerequisite: [The Founding Father](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561751) Objective: Headbutt the light bulb in the lighthouse reeled in for the [The Founding Father](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=561751) event Rewards: - 3 Illuminati Points - 5,000 Karma Points

title: Steve (Goat)
description: *"Steve was rescued but now he doesn't have that long to live..."* Location: Reward for completing the [Rescue Steve](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558006) event.

title: Geta (Feet)
description: *"The only sandal you are allowed to rock with socks."* Location: Beside the pool at [Yakedo Hot Springs](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=557901)

title: Plunger (Head)
description: *"Unclog your brain"* Location: Inside the [Fossil Fuel](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558004) toilet building. Complete the [Needle in a Crate Stack](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558010) event to open the bathroom door to access.

title: Gardener (Back)
description: *"Possess the power to keep plants alive for more than a week."* Ability: Plant a magical bean that you can baa to grow. Location: Purchased from the wardrobe for 8,000 Karma Points after completing the [Green Thumbs](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558013) event. Instinct: [Make 15 Magic Plants Grow 15 Times Each](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558059)

title: Model Trailer (Back)
description: *"Limited edition 1956 redneck trailer miniature. 1:12 scale, pristine condition. Rednecks sold separately."* Location: Reward for completing the [Backyard Science](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558049) event

title: Mermaid Comb (Head)
description: *"Aquaman wishes he was this cool"* Ability: Shoots a fish in the direction you're facing. Location: Found on the rock in the center of the pond after completing the [Fishing in Bulk](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558052) event Instinct: [Slap People With a Fish](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558058)

title: Scarecrow (Goat)
description: *"Pull my straw"* Location: Reward for completing the [Children of the Hay](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558062) event

title: Miss Talent (Head)
description: *"Congrats! Now solve world peace"* Location: Reward for completing the [Farmer's Got Talent](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558077) event

title: 2nd Place Ribbon (Back)
description: *"1st place loser"* Location: Reward for getting second place in the [Farmer's Got Talent](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/san-angora?locationIds=558077) event

title: Ricer (Head)

title: Corporate Wellness
description: Description: Give some park workers a break Solution: ||Find three park workers and lick 'n' drag them over to the massage tables on the [Seaside](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092173). Once on the table, bounce on their back until it breaks.|| Rewards: - 500 Karma Points - 200 Dizzy Tokens {{dztok width=16}}

title: The Big Score
description: Description: Get lots of points, one way or another Solution: ||Break the hatch off the feeding chute and then shove as many things in as you can until the score is reached. No just meatballs, cram everything from the bench to the dynamite in to keep the score going.|| Rewards: - [Ms. Cthilla's Tentacles (Back)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092153) - 500 Dizzy Tokens {{dztok width=16}}

title: A Real Adventure
description: Description: Set the rafts free Solution: ||Aim a squirtosaurus cannon at the electric gate until it explodes, then use the squirtosaurus cannon on the other side of the rapids to blast one of the rafts down and out to sea.|| Rewards: - 500 Karma Points - 500 Dizzy Tokens {{dztok width=16}}

title: Chasing Stars
description: Description: Make the rockets reach for the sky Solution: ||Take a Rocket Fuel sample from the free sample stand nearby and place it in the fuel supply for [Low Orbit](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092185) then hit the red button.|| Rewards: - 500 Karma Points - 500 Dizzy Tokens {{dztok width=16}}

title: Repair Despair
description: Description: Fix [The Log](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092186)'s track Objectives: - Bring some helping hands to fix the track - Start the Roller Coaster Solution: ||The track is broken in four places. Lick and drag any four people to the broken points on the track to "fix" them.|| Rewards: - 500 Karma Points - 800 Dizzy Tokens {{dztok width=16}}

title: Sticky Situation
description: Description: Bring an XXXXXL cotton candy cone to the plumber Solution: ||Go to the Candy Floss stall on the road between [Dizzy Castle](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092175) and [Founder's Plaza](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092178). Add items to the candy floss until it's extra large, then bring it over to the plumber in the maintenance area of the [VelociRafters](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092184) ride.|| Rewards: - 500 Karma Points - 200 Dizzy Tokens {{dztok width=16}}

title: Attach 100 balloons on things

title: Hit a nasty hoop in the Back Office
description: Category: Dizzyworld Solution: ||Find the hidden basketball court in the Back Office and get a basketball into the hoop. The easiest way to do this is to jump up onto the hoop and drop it in.|| Rewards: 3,500 Karma Points

title: Bounce 20 times while in a single gum bubble
description: Category: Gears Required Gear: [Gum Bubble (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092073) Solution: ||Use the [Gum Bubble (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092073) to create a bubble and get inside it. Stay inside until it's bounced 20 times without popping.|| Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Put 25 things in gum bubbles

title: Hit 20 NPCs with a Bumper Car
