description: Category: Dizzyworld Prerequisite: [Rising Heat](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092151) Solution: ||Grab one of the cheese balls from [Mount Vesuvio](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092180) after completing [Rising Heat](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092151) and drag it over objects and people until it's consumed 50 things.|| Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Send 10 Cleaners flying to the heavens
description: Category: Dizzyworld Solution: ||Headbutt 10 cleaners causing their powerwashers to blast them off into the sky.|| Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Reach warp speed on a Coaster Coil track
description: Category: Gears Required Gear: [Coaster Coil (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092077) Solution: ||Use the [Coaster Coil (Head)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092077) to build a fairly long and straight rollercoaster track. Jump on it and grind the rail until you reach warp speed.|| Rewards: 3,500 Karma Points

title: Have 5 things stick to yourself at the same time
description: Category: Gears Required Gear: [Cotton Candy Suit (Body)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092082) Solution: ||Equip the [Cotton Candy Suit (Body)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092082) from the [Gear Vending Machine](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092070) and run around until 5 objects stick to you.|| Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Crack open a Dino Egg at the Lookout Point
description: Category: Dizzyworld Solution: ||Take a Dino Egg from the [VelociRafters](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092184) ride and bring it to [Lookout Point](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092177), then headbutt it open.|| Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Grab 50 things with the tentacles
description: Category: Gears Required Gear: [Ms. Cthilla's Tentacles (Back)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092153) Prerequisite: [The Big Score](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092154) Objective: Equip [Ms. Cthilla's Tentacles (Back)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092153) and walk around the park letting the tentacles grab objects you pass. Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Baa on top of Ms. Cthilla
description: Category: Dizzyworld Solution: ||Baa on top of the [Ms. Chtilla X-Perience](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092183) ride. An easy way to get up here is to complete the [Fixer Upper](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092155) event and jump from the flying house.|| Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Make 5 park workers fall in love with visitors
description: Category: Gears Required Gear: [Cupid (Back)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092083) Solution: ||Obtain [Cupid (Back)](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092083) from the [Gear Vending Machine](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092069) and use it's ability on park workers while they're stood near visitors. If you're too close, they'll love you instead.|| Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Feed a hungry dinosaur a Cheese Ball
description: Category: Dizzyworld Prerequisite: [Rising Heat](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092151) Solution: ||Grab a cheeseball from [Mount Vesuvio](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092180) after completing the [Rising Heat](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092151) event and bring it to the hungry dinosaur in the [VelociRafters](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092184) ride.|| Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Add 5 logs to the Mega Jack 9000
description: Category: Dizzyworld Prerequisite: [Repair Despair](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092158) Solution: ||Complete the [Repair Despair](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092158) event to power the Mega Jack 9000, then bring 5 logs from the [L.O.G Machine](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1096246) over to it.|| Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

title: Activate a Sawblade to hit a Log passenger
description: Category: Dizzyworld Prerequisite: [Repair Despair](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092158) Solution: ||Place one or more people into the Log Ride after completing [Repair Despair](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092158), then headbutt one of the sawblades along the track at the right time to hit the people on it.|| Rewards: 3,500 Karma Points

description: Category: Dizzyworld Solution: ||Lick and drag a security guard over to the castle gates on the north side of [Dizzy Castle](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092175) and then press the lever to drop the gate on them.|| Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

description: Category: Dizzyworld Solution: ||Lick someone and drag them across the keys repeatedly.|| Rewards: 1,500 Karma Points

title: Juggle a Juggling Club 10 times in a row
description: Category: Dizzyworld Solution: ||Get a Juggling Club from a [Gear Vending Machine](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?search=gear_vending_machine%20%26%26%20category%3A29198). Once done, take another Rocket Fuel sample and place it in the fuel supply for [Low Orbit](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092185) then hit the red button.|| Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

description: Category: Dizzyworld Prerequisite: [Rising Heat](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092151) Solution: ||Lick and drag one of the princess performers around the park over to the [Mount Vesuvio](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092180) ride and launch it after completing the [Rising Heat](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092151) event.|| Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points

Licking and pull the statues finger causes it to fart and it can be aimed while doing so. Start a fire nearby by heatbutting a gas canister or using the dynamite up on the [Ms. Chtilla X-Perience](https://mapgenie.io/goat-simulator-3/maps/ticket-to-dizzyworld?locationIds=1092183) platform, then aim the fart at it.|| Rewards: 2,500 Karma Points
